{"items": [{"type": "definition", "term": "AI", "text": "The  State  defines  AI  as  a  machine-based  system  that  (1)  can,  for  a  given  set  of human-defined objectives, make predictions, recommendations, or decisions influencing real or virtual environments; (2) uses machine and human-based inputs to perceive real and virtual environments and abstracts those perceptions into models through analysis in an automated manner; and (3) uses model inference to formulate options for information or action."}, {"type": "obligation", "text": "requires DoIT to adopt policies and procedures, {"items": [
{"type": "obligation", "text": "This  bill  requires  the  Maryland  State  Department  of  Education  (MSDE)  to  provide guidance on artificial intelligence (AI) to local school systems, educators, parents, and students through an online platform.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the Maryland State Department of Education (MSDE)", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Local school systems must adopt an AI policy aligned with the guidance within 120 days of its release, designate an AI coordinator, and procure AI tools consistent with specified requirements adopted by the Department of Information Technology (DoIT).", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Local school systems", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "within 120 days of its release"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "MSDE must also (1) develop and publish a rubric and other evaluative tools to assist local school systems in the evaluation of AI tools selected for use by the local school  system", "force": "obligation", "binds": "MSDE", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "incorporate  AI  literacy  into  workforce  preparation  standards  and computer science standards for kindergarten through grade 12 by June 1, 2027", "force": "obligation", "binds": "MSDE", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "by June 1, 2027"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "provide professional development in AI to educators and school leaders", "force": "obligation", "binds": "MSDE", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "staff and support the new Maryland AI Education Collaborative on Artificial Intelligence in K-12 Education", "force": "obligation", "binds": "MSDE", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "which  must  issue specified reports  and  recommendations", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the Maryland AI Education Collaborative on Artificial Intelligence in K-12 Education", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "MSDE must provide  guidance  on  AI  to  local  school  systems, educators, parents, and students through an online platform", "force": "obligation", "binds": "MSDE", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "MSDE, in consultation with other interested stakeholders, must publish separate guidance on its website for students, educators, administrators, and parents and guardians.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "MSDE", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "in consultation with other interested stakeholders"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "MSDE must annually review and update the guidance as necessary.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "MSDE", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "annually"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "MSDE must also develop strategies to assist local boards of education and county superintendents to implement the guidelines and best practices.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "MSDE", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null}
]}
